decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-f42cb542e4b7] says PR #6615 reverts an earlier change titled "ci(e2es): export kind logs on failure". The subject is the project's CI end-to-end test setup, not a product surface. The change is that the step exporting kind cluster logs when e2e tests fail is removed again. The "ci(e2es)" scope means this is test infrastructure, so it's enough to write it up as informational, with no customer environment exposed and no operator consequence. The evidence doesn't say outright that operators are unaffected; that comes from the CI scope label, which is why confidence is low.
